name: Aroha Renata
bio:
Aroha Renata has dedicated her life to motorsport strategy, a passion ignited by watching her grandfather, a renowned mechanic, tinker with engines in their small hometown. She started her career as a data analyst for a local racing team, quickly proving her aptitude for dissecting complex information and formulating winning strategies. Her ability to anticipate track conditions and competitor tactics earned her a reputation as a rising star.

Over the years, Aroha has worked with several successful teams, contributing to numerous championship victories. Known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her meticulous approach, she excels at identifying opportunities and mitigating risks. At EVO Racing Team, she's respected not only for her strategic insights, but also for her ability to mentor younger members of the team. 

What sets Aroha apart is her innate understanding of the human element in racing. She believes that a successful strategy requires not just technical expertise, but also a deep understanding of the drivers' capabilities and the team's dynamics. She can often be found having quiet conversations with drivers, understanding their feelings about the car, and the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with natural waves
physical.description: Aroha has a warm, friendly face and a sturdy build that speaks to years of focused work.

quirks: Always carries a small pounamu pendant for good luck.
Insists on having a specific type of green tea before every race.
Quietly hums traditional Māori songs when deeply focused on data analysis.
